headline: Juventus after the 0-3: still clear favourites against Rennes
summary: Juventus lost 0-3 at home to Lazio on Sunday, their only defeat in their last five games. On Thursday they host Rennes in the Europa League, where they have won both matches and have 6 points. Rennes doubt striker Estéban Lepaul, who has 7 goals this season, and they have conceded 10 goals in their last five games. The market average makes Juventus 60.7% favourites, rates them 1 goal better, and expects 2.75 goals in Turin.
read: Juventus are clear 60.7% favourites at home, and the price holds despite the 0-3 defeat to Lazio because their Europa League form — two wins and a +6 goal difference — is the strongest part of their season. Rennes arrive with four points from two European games but a defence that has shipped 10 goals in five, and with top scorer Estéban Lepaul a serious doubt after his penalty hat-trick at Paris FC ended in injury.

facts.fact: Juventus are priced at 60.7% to win, more than three times Rennes' 17.3%.
facts.meaning: A home win is the clear market expectation in Turin, with the draw at 22.0%.

facts.fact: Juventus lost 0-3 at home to Lazio in Serie A on Sunday.
facts.meaning: It is their only defeat in the last five, and it came in front of their own crowd four days before this game.

facts.fact: Spalletti said after the Lazio defeat that his side lacked tempo, ideas, running and the desire to work hard.
facts.meaning: The coach himself framed the performance as an attitude problem, which makes this Europa League night an immediate response test.

facts.fact: Rennes striker Estéban Lepaul has 7 goals in 719 minutes this season and is a serious doubt after going off injured late at Paris FC.
facts.meaning: Losing him would remove the finisher from a Rennes side that has been scoring freely but leaking heavily.

facts.fact: Juventus are without Francisco Conceição, their most-used absentee this season with 525 minutes across nine appearances.
facts.meaning: They must replace a regular wide midfielder on top of Locatelli and Yildiz also being unavailable.

facts.fact: Rennes lost 4-3 away at Paris FC on Sunday in a game featuring four converted penalties.
facts.meaning: They scored three away from home and still lost, which sums up a side scoring and conceding at the same rate.

facts.fact: Juventus top the Europa League league phase with 6 points and a +6 goal difference from two matches.
facts.meaning: They have won both European games — 5-0 at home to NEC Nijmegen and 2-1 away at Celta Vigo — so this is the fixture where the domestic mood can be answered.

facts.fact: Rennes sit 13th of 36 in the same Europa League table with 4 points from two games.
facts.meaning: They have taken a win and a draw from their opening two European matches while sitting mid-table domestically.

sources.fact: Juventus lost 3-0 at home to Lazio in Serie A on 18 October.
Spalletti said after the Lazio defeat that his side lacked tempo, ideas, running and the desire to work hard.
Spalletti said in his pre-match press conference that he listened to the players in a meeting and had confirmation of their availability and honesty.
Most Juventus fans left the Allianz Stadium in the closing minutes of the 3-0 home defeat to Lazio.
Buffon believes Spalletti deserves time to turn things around and said the problem cannot just be the coach.
The match is Juventus's third fixture of the Europa League league phase.
Tuttosport reports Juventus's final training session before Rennes featured a small-sided game and a double defence.
Rennes lost 4-3 away at Paris FC in Ligue 1, a match that featured four converted penalties.
